participantCase.question: Let [26] = {1,2,...,26}. Choose a set A such that no two distinct elements of A differ by 4 or by 7, and A contains exactly three elements of S = {2,6,10,14,18,22,26}. What is the largest possible value of |A|? Give one maximizing set and a concise upper-bound argument. A numerical guess without a valid construction and bound is incomplete.

propositions.text: The stated optimum is the true maximum cardinality.
The proposed construction lies in [26], has no repeated elements, and has the stated size.
The construction contains exactly three elements of S and no forbidden difference.
The upper-bound argument rules out every larger feasible set.

participantCase.question: All variables A through J are Boolean. XOR means exactly one operand is true. Premises: (1) exactly two of A,B,C,D are true; (2) E iff A XOR C; (3) F iff (B and not D) or (C and D); (4) G implies E XOR F; (5) H iff G or (A and not F); (6) I iff H XOR D; (7) J iff (I and B) or (not H and C); (8) exactly two of E,F,G,I,J are true; (9) A implies not B; (10) C implies G or J. Classify the claim 'D is true and F is false' as ENTAILED, CONTRADICTED, or OPEN. ENTAILED means true in every satisfying assignment, CONTRADICTED means false in every satisfying assignment, and OPEN means both truth values occur. The typed certificate must use variable order A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J; encode true as 1 and false as 0; exhaustively list every premise-satisfying 10-bit assignment; and partition that same complete list by query truth. A prose derivation or only decisive examples does not replace the exhaustive typed table.

propositions.text: Every satisfying assignment makes D true and F false.
The requested classification follows under the stated Boolean and XOR semantics.

participantCase.question: Times below are seconds after the same nominal 10:00:00. Clock A and clock B each have an unknown fixed offset from UTC in the inclusive range -4 to +4 seconds, where local time = UTC + offset. A's log says lease A was held on the closed local interval [12,26] and a packet was sent at local time 24. B's log says the packet was received at local time 31 and lease B was held on the closed local interval [32,46]. The packet's real one-way latency was between 1 and 5 seconds inclusive. There is no other cross-clock evidence. Classify the claim 'there was no instant at which both leases were held' as SUPPORTED, REFUTED, or OPEN. Show the decisive relative-offset bounds or two feasible clock worlds. Touching at one endpoint counts as overlap.

propositions.text: The no-overlap claim has one determinate truth value from the supplied record.
The packet timing determines one exact relative clock offset.
At least one feasible clock world has no overlap and at least one has overlap.

participantCase.question: Task Monki must create at most one remote provider turn for each durable local work item and must eventually recover its remote ID after any client crash or lost reply. The provider guarantees create(turnKey) is idempotent forever for a given unique key and lookup(turnKey) returns the same remote ID. A local database transaction is atomic; a stable unique key can be persisted before any network call. Provider completion is telemetry and must not advance Task Monki workflow without separate local verification. Choose the smallest protocol satisfying all requirements: A) call create with a fresh key, then persist key and ID; after a crash use a new key. B) transactionally persist a pending intent and stable key, call create(key), then persist the returned ID; after restart retry or lookup with that same key; advance workflow only in the later local-verification transaction. C) mark the task running, call create, and use a new key whenever no reply arrives. D) use a hash of the prompt as the key and advance workflow on provider completion. Explain the decisive crash point.

propositions.text: The chosen protocol prevents duplicate remote turns across a lost reply and crash.
The chosen protocol can recover the remote ID without inventing a new key.
Workflow advancement remains controlled by separate local verification.
The stable key is durable before the first provider side effect.
